messages:
Ally Rivera: Quick sync note from the isolation launch huddle. We need a tight, ship-ready checklist for tenant isolation launches (multi-region + routing policy).
Jon Park: Agree. Minimal must-haves: migration tool, canary automation, capacity headroom check, and customer pricing stub.
Meera Shah: Add quality gate: eval suite run with blocking thresholds. If model variant changes during migration, block on regression >2% absolute.
Owen Brooks: Ops: define headroom metric and evacuation default per template. Proposal: headroom >=10% before full cutover; soft residency spills, hard residency rejects.
Lina Torres: Sales wants a simple one-liner for collateral and lead time estimates. I'll draft those once pricing bands are set.
ops-bot: Reminder: create RFC with checklist + owners; tag infra, legal, and finance.
Ally Rivera: Owners: Jon -> migration automation; Meera -> quality/eval gating; Owen -> evacuation playbook; Lina -> sales collateral + pricing check. Will post RFC after owners add first drafts.
